question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word.

**Relay**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Hold.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Relay **means *to receive and then pass on a signal or message.* (**अग्रसर करना, पहुँचाना**)

 
 
• **Antonyms:** hold, keep, retain, check.
 
• **Synonyms:** transfer, send, impart, repeat, communicate, spread, circulate.
 
• **Example:** Smack and Smug both brothers <
